title: Design: Long Service For names never cover Memo on the payer's Invoices tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, a customer the work is for, with a long name with spaces that no other customer has, at least 60 characters (for example Northern Plains Heavy Truck and Trailer Repair Services West).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, a customer the work is for, whose name is customer A's name with every space taken out (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, a customer the work is for, with a name that no other customer has and that includes each of the characters & " ' < > (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Parts> & Sons).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, the payer.
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have three new work orders for this test, for customer A, customer B and customer C in turn, each invoiced and unpaid, all billed to customer D.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p5-02-after-a-j-invoices.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer D's page.
  2. Click the Invoices tab.
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 pixels wide.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer D's page opens.

Step 2:

  • The columns read Date, Type, No., Service For, Memo, Total, Balance, Status, Action, all visible without scrolling sideways.
  • The Service For cells name customer A, customer B and customer C.
  • Each name stays inside its own Service For cell: no part of it covers the Memo column, its heading or the row under it.
  • Customer C's name shows exactly as saved: the & " ' < > characters appear as typed, not changed into other characters or codes.

Step 3:

  • Every column is still visible without scrolling sideways.
  • Each Service For name still stays inside its own cell and does not cover Memo.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-R6: “The Bill To's Invoices tab shows a "Service For" column naming the customer the work was for.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "A & J, Invoices" (page 5 "Getting paid", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p5-02-after-a-j-invoices.png

The design's own words:

  • “New column after No.: header "Service For", naming the customer the work was for.”

The design draws this place with ordinary names only; it draws no long name without spaces and no name with & " ' < >. The stress check follows the design-case checklist (lesson L-21); the expected words come from the PRD quotes above.
